title: Create a shadow tree
summary: A shadow root is a separate group of page parts inside an element.
introduction: A shadow root is a separate group of page parts inside an element. Your task: Change the internal paragraph message.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for create a shadow tree

blocks.text: A shadow root is a separate group of page parts inside an element. It helps keep a component's internal structure together.
Run these HTML examples in this site's HTML playground. Each example defines its own custom element in a fresh page. No extra JavaScript library is needed.

blocks.code:
<shadow-note></shadow-note>
<script>
  class ShadowNote extends HTMLElement {
    constructor() {
      super();
      const root = this.attachShadow({ mode: "open" });
      const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
      paragraph.textContent = "Inside the component";
      root.append(paragraph);
    }
  }
  customElements.define("shadow-note", ShadowNote);
</script>
blocks.title: Create a shadow tree

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `textContent` reads or replaces plain text inside an element. It does not interpret the supplied words as HTML.
`createElement` makes a new element in memory. Append it to the document when you want it to appear.
`customElements.define` registers a hyphenated tag name with its class. Register a given name only once per document.

blocks.text: The note displays a paragraph kept inside its shadow root.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Call super before using this in a custom element constructor. A shadow root is not a security boundary.
